# Oxira (أوكسيرا)

> Oxira is a Saudi digital transformation and IT company based in Riyadh. It builds websites for small businesses in minutes, sells monthly add-ons that bring them customers, and develops custom software and AI agents for companies.

Commercial registration: 7050917793 · VAT: 314064774700003 · Address: 426 Al-Sulaymaniyah, Al-Urubah Road, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia · Email: info@oxira.sa · Phone/WhatsApp: +966 59 669 4021

## Website builder

- [Website builder (Oxira Studio)](https://oxira.sa/website-builder/): pick a design, describe the business and edit it live with an AI designer. Hosting, domain, logo and support included.
- [Online in a day](https://oxira.sa/online-in-a-day/): one bundle that launches a business online within a working day: website with domain and hosting, an AI agent that answers customers on WhatsApp, and the Google Maps business profile.
- [Free website audit](https://oxira.sa/website-audit/): checks speed, SEO basics and mobile readiness of any website and emails a report.

## Add-ons (monthly subscriptions)

- [Google visibility (SEO)](https://oxira.sa/products/google-seo/): Search Console connection, monthly title and description improvements, helpful articles and local service pages approved by the owner, keyword rank tracking, lead counting (calls, WhatsApp, forms) and a monthly report. Basic 299 SAR, Growth 799 SAR per month. Works for websites built with Oxira and for external websites (WordPress auto-publishing).
- [Social media management](https://oxira.sa/products/social-media-management/): monthly content plan with ready designs, Saudi seasonal calendar, owner approval and automatic publishing to Instagram and Facebook, AI comment replies (Pro), monthly report. Basic 699 SAR, Pro 1,499 SAR per month.
- [Ads management](https://oxira.sa/products/ads-management/): monthly Meta ad plans that run only after the owner approves, with a fixed total budget and end date; the ad budget is paid by the client directly to Meta. 999 SAR per month.
- [Online booking](https://oxira.sa/products/booking-system/)
- [Digital menu and QR](https://oxira.sa/products/digital-menu-qr/)
- [More Google reviews](https://oxira.sa/products/google-reviews/)
- [AI chat assistant](https://oxira.sa/products/ai-chatbot/)
- [Monthly social media content](https://oxira.sa/products/social-media-content/)
- [Event tickets](https://oxira.sa/products/event-tickets/)

Prices exclude 15% VAT.

## Services for companies

- [Services](https://oxira.sa/services/): digital transformation consulting, custom software and mobile apps, IT infrastructure, smart home systems, AI solutions.
- [AI agents](https://oxira.sa/ai-agents/): an AI agent on WhatsApp and the website that answers customers 24/7 in their dialect, understands voice notes and logs requests.
- [AI WhatsApp employee, free trial](https://oxira.sa/whatsapp-agent/) ([English](https://oxira.sa/en/whatsapp-agent/)): enter a website link or a short business description and get a live demo of an AI WhatsApp employee trained on the business in about a minute, with a shareable demo link. Basic 399 SAR per month (answers customer questions 24/7 from the business info, replies in the customer's dialect and language, hands the chat to staff). Pro 799 SAR per month (adds bookings and orders, voice notes, instant notifications, handover with a chat summary). Prices exclude 15% VAT; the WhatsApp number is connected with the Oxira team on a short call, and the team sends an invoice after the subscription request. Meta message fees, if any, depend on usage.
- [Classti](https://oxira.sa/classti/): K-12 school management platform by Oxira.
- [Company website design](https://oxira.sa/services/web-design/): bilingual company websites, from a ready site in a day to custom platforms.
- [E-commerce store design](https://oxira.sa/services/ecommerce-store/): custom online stores with payments and shipping; AI agents for stores on Salla, Zid and Shopify.
- [Software development](https://oxira.sa/services/software-development/): custom business systems, web platforms, integrations.
- [Mobile app development](https://oxira.sa/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android apps with a dashboard.
- [Digital transformation](https://oxira.sa/services/digital-transformation/): assessment, roadmap and delivery for public entities and companies.
- [Business automation](https://oxira.sa/services/business-automation/): system integration, automatic reports, AI document reading.

## Locations

- [Riyadh](https://oxira.sa/locations/riyadh/): head office, 426 Al Sulaymaniyah, Al Urubah Rd.
- [Gulf](https://oxira.sa/locations/gulf/): UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman, served remotely.
- [Egypt](https://oxira.sa/locations/egypt/): AI WhatsApp agents that reply in Egyptian Arabic, websites and automation, served remotely.

Service and location pages, the AI WhatsApp employee page and the blog are in Arabic and English (/en/...).

## Blog

Practical guides for business owners, in Arabic (https://oxira.sa/blog/) and English (https://oxira.sa/en/blog/). Each English article has the same slug as its Arabic original.

- [How much does a website cost in Saudi Arabia?](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/website-cost-saudi/): what drives website costs, freelancer vs. agency vs. website builder, and how to compare quotes.
- [How to choose a booking system for your clinic or salon](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/booking-system-guide/): what to look for in online appointment booking.
- [QR digital menus for restaurants and cafés](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/digital-menu-qr/): benefits, what to include, QR printing tips, keeping prices current.
- [How to get more Google reviews the right way](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/google-reviews/): Business Profile setup, asking for reviews, replying, and what Google's policies prohibit (incentives, fake reviews, review gating).
- [AI chatbots for business](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/ai-chatbot-business/): what a website AI chatbot does, its limits and responsible use.
- [Choosing a web design company in Saudi Arabia: 10 questions](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/choose-web-design-company/): questions to ask before signing, ownership of domain and content, red flags.
- [Benefits of an AI agent on WhatsApp for business](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/whatsapp-ai-agent-benefits/): 24/7 replies, voice notes, order logging, and WhatsApp Business Platform policy on AI chatbots.
- [Starting an online store in Saudi Arabia](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/start-online-store-saudi/): Saudi-specific steps: Business Platform verification, payments and shipping, ZATCA e-invoicing.
- [Business automation for SMEs](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/business-automation-guide/): how to find tasks worth automating, examples and common mistakes.
- [Mobile app or website?](https://oxira.sa/en/blog/app-or-website/): how to decide which one a business needs, and when to have both.
